_comment: A Descriptive Book sold **blank**, and that is what makes each one a different Age.
A trade's `given_item_modifiers` run once, when the offer is built -- so writing the book here would
sell the same world over and over. A blank book writes itself on its first inventory tick
(`DescriptiveBookItem.inventoryTick`) from a fresh seed, so every copy bought is somewhere new, and it
has its title before the player has finished closing the trade screen.
